_comment: Every field the system knows about. The intake UI is generated from this file. Derived fields (see app/schema.py) are computed, never typed, and are listed here with "derived": true so startup validation can account for them.
_date_formats: A date field is entered once and displayed however the template needs it. "format" picks the rendering: mdy = 3/9/2024, long = March 9, 2024, long_ordinal = 9th day of March, 2024 (for prose that reads "on the ____,"), iso = 2024-03-09. Default is mdy.
_defaults: "default" is a small Jinja string used when the field is left blank, evaluated after derived fields are computed.
_questionnaire: A group with "questionnaire": false is left out of the .docx questionnaire emailed to adoptive parents — it is information the office fills in, not the family. A single field can opt out the same way, even when the rest of its group belongs on the questionnaire.
_stepparent_convention: For every 'stepparent' matter, Petitioner 1 is the biological/legal-custodial parent (already has rights, is not adopting) and Petitioner 2 is the spouse who is adopting. The 'stepparent' field group captures the other, non-petitioner biological parent (the one whose consent, termination, or non-support excuse the court needs to see).

fields.label: Filing county
fields.help: County whose district court this is filed in.

fields.label: Case number
fields.help: Leave blank to print FA-<year>-_____ for the clerk to fill in.
Pulled from settings, not the intake form.

The attorney's signature image, uploaded once under Office details and stored beside settings.json. Printed on the attorney's signature lines. Optional: with no image on file, or with signing switched off for a filing, those lines print as they always have.

fields.label: Date the Petitioners married
fields.help: Prints as "the 11th day of October, 2014". Only asked when there are two petitioners.
Computed from date of birth. Drives whether the child's consent is required.
Computed from date of birth. Drives whether the child's consent is required.

fields.label: Mother's rights
fields.help: Relinquished = signed a permanent relinquishment. Terminated = rights ended by court order.

fields.label: Date of foster placement
fields.help: Prints as "in September of 2024" in the body of the petition. Only the month and year are printed, so the day may be approximate.

fields.label: Are the Petitioners related to the child(ren)?
fields.help: Yes adds a sentence to paragraph 2 of the Petition naming the relationship. In the "case" group, not "dhs", because a kinship placement is not only a DHS matter — it is asked on every intake.

fields.label: Relationship to the child(ren)
fields.help: Completes "related to the minor child(ren) being the ____" — for example "maternal grandparents" or "paternal aunt and uncle".

fields.label: Does ICWA apply?
fields.help: Selects between the ICWA and non-ICWA versions of the relevant paragraphs in both the Petition and the Decree.

fields.label: Tribe
fields.help: Pick one of these five and the Notice to Tribe fills in that tribe's ICW office address automatically. Any other tribe can still be typed in — the notice still generates, just without a pre-filled address.

fields.label: Date the Petition for Adoption will be heard
fields.help: Fills ¶1 of the Notice to Tribe: "will be heard on the 14th day of May, 2026". Leave blank while the hearing is unset and it prints the blanks for the clerk.

fields.label: City of the courthouse
fields.help: The town the district courthouse sits in, usually the county seat. Fills ¶1 of the Notice to Tribe: "in the District Courthouse at Wagoner, Wagoner County".

fields.label: Judge hearing the matter
fields.help: Optional. Fills ¶1 of the Notice to Tribe after "before the Honorable Judge". Left blank it prints a line to write on.

fields.label: Date the notice is mailed
fields.help: The date the notice goes out by registered mail, return receipt requested. Fills the Certificate of Service on page 2. Leave blank to print the blanks and date it by hand.

fields.label: Other biological parent's name
fields.help: The non-petitioner biological parent — used only in step-parent matters.

fields.label: Other biological parent is the child's

fields.help: Derived from other_parent_relationship: mother -> she, father -> he.
mother -> her, father -> him. Use where the parent is the object: 'notice was served on ___'.
mother -> her, father -> his. Use before a noun: '___ consent', '___ parental rights'.

fields.label: Other parent's consent status
fields.help: consents = will sign a written consent. terminated = rights already terminated by court order. excused_nonsupport = consent not required under 10 O.S. 7505-4.2 due to a year of willful non-support/non-contact.

fields.label: Hourly rate
fields.help: The office's rate, in dollars. Customarily 300.

fields.label: Hours worked to date
fields.help: Hours, to two decimal places — 13.5 prints as 13.50.

fields.label: Filing fee
fields.help: Varies by county and changes over time. Customarily 184.14. Enter 0 and the line is left out of the affidavit altogether.

fields.label: Amended birth certificate fee
fields.help: Customarily 40. Enter 0 and the line is left out of the affidavit altogether.
The costs-and-expenses sentence, built from the four figures above with the total added up rather than typed.

fields.label: Fees and costs to date, in words
fields.help: Leave blank and the Affidavit of Expenditures states the four figures above, adding them up for you. Fill this in only to override that sentence wholesale — anything typed here is printed verbatim and nothing checks that it totals correctly.
